content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Clearwater

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and measurable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific education and hours-of-experience thresholds for the PMP credential. Gather documentation of your project work, roles, and responsibilities. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can clarify eligibility questions before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Formal Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend interactive, instructor-led sessions covering all five process groups and ten knowledge areas. Schedule aligns with working professionals' calendars. Upon completion, receive your Certificate of Attendance—required to apply for the PMP exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application and Exam Fee
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account and complete the official PMP application, detailing your project experience and education. PMI will verify your background. Once approved, pay the exam fee and receive authorization to schedule your exam window through an authorized testing center.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's post-bootcamp study resources, practice exams, and Q&A support to reinforce core concepts. Schedule your computer-based exam at a testing center convenient to your location. The exam is comprehensive and proctored. Success requires solid grasp of processes, inputs, outputs, and situational judgment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential Over Three Years
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, project work, and professional involvement. Complete your PDU requirement within the three-year renewal cycle to maintain active PMP status. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning resources to support your renewal goals.
